safe_temperature.temperature: No minimum internal cook temperature required for consumption; pasteurized commercial tofu can be eaten cold/raw (e.g. silken tofu), or heated to 165°F (73.9°C) if reheating prepared dishes/leftovers

source.name: Every Grain of Rice - Fuchsia Dunlop & FDA Food Safety Guidelines
source.location: Silken Tofu Cold Preparation & Ready-to-Eat Plant Proteins

methods.cut: cubes, slabs, or strips (extra-firm or firm tofu)
methods.heat: Medium-high heat in a well-oiled skillet (cast-iron or nonstick)
methods.time: 4 to 6 minutes per side (approx. 10 to 12 minutes total)
methods.doneness: Deep golden-brown crust formed on all sides, exterior crisp, interior firm yet tender
methods.rest: Drain 1 to 2 minutes on paper towels before tossing with glaze or sauce
methods.tips: Press tofu between paper towels with a heavy plate for 15-20 minutes before cooking to remove surface moisture; light dusting with cornstarch produces the crispiest shatter-resistant crust.

source.name: The Kitchn Crispy Tofu Technique Guide & Food Network
source.location: Skill Testing Feature: 10 Crispy Tofu Methods

methods.time: 12 to 15 minutes, shaking the basket halfway through
methods.doneness: Puffed, deeply golden, and crisp on all exterior edges
methods.tips: Toss pressed cubes with a teaspoon of neutral oil and a pinch of salt/cornstarch in a single uncrowded layer; overcrowding traps steam and prevents crisping.

source.name: The Complete Veggie Air Fryer Cookbook
source.location: Vibrant Tofu Larb & Crispy Tofu Sections

methods.heat: Medium heat skillet with olive oil or vegan butter
methods.doneness: Excess water fully cooked off, curds lightly golden and tender, resembling scrambled eggs
methods.tips: Crumble tofu by hand into rustic curds; add a pinch of turmeric for classic egg-like yellow color and nutritional yeast or black salt for savory depth.

source.name: Frugal Vegan (Katie Koteen and Kate Kasbee)

methods.cut: block or thick slices (silken or soft tofu)
methods.rest: Drain whey from container for 5 minutes before dressing
methods.tips: Invert block gently onto a serving plate to prevent cracking, score into bite-sized squares without cutting through the base, and spoon seasoned soy dressing over top.

avoid.warning: Failing to press water out of firm tofu before searing or air-frying: excess internal water turns into steam, preventing the formation of a crisp exterior and diluting seasoning.
avoid.source: The Kitchn Crispy Tofu Technique Guide

avoid.warning: Rough handling or vigorous stirring of silken tofu, which fractures the delicate custard structure into watery mush.
avoid.source: Every Grain of Rice - Fuchsia Dunlop

avoid.warning: Leaving opened or cut tofu unrefrigerated; tofu must be kept in fresh water in the refrigerator and consumed within 3 to 5 days.
